messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] SEV2: High error rate for prod inference endpoints in az1a. Symptom: NLB 502/504 spikes + increased tail latency. Pager routed to infra-oncall. Incident ID RWI-2026-3881

alice: oncall here, ack. will start triage. tagging @bob @carol.

bob: looking at host metrics now. seeing short rx/t x bursts on several ENIs, tx_queue depth rising, NIC tx_drops intermittently. nat-gw CPU at 95% for az1a.

carol: DNS resolver queue depth also spiking (udp qlen 500 -> 8k) leading to retransmits. not full resolver failure but huge latencies for lookups.

alice: customer impact? which routes most affected?

ryan-cust-ops: 12% of inference requests from az1a are returning 502/504, elevated p50/p95 latency + some timeouts. Affected customers: mix of hosted API and some Dedicated lanes with AZ affinity.

dave: prepping traffic handoff. recommend shifting weights off az1a to eu1/usw2 to reduce pressure while we mitigate. will run weighted LB change.

netsys-bot: run: set-lb-weights --service=prod-inference --weights '{"az1a":60,"eu1":40}' -> accepted. rolling changes to LB target groups.

bob: taking immediate host actions: restarting proxy process on 4 nodes showing stuck tx queues, draining from LB after restart.

carol: pushing resolver fallback: enable cache-only mode and increase UDP socket backlog: /infra/configs/resolver/fallback=true backlog=8192 -> applied to az1a pool.

alice: monitoring metrics. if error rate not down to <5% in 5m we'll cut az1a weight to 0 and fail over fully.

bob: proxy restarts succeeded on 3/4 nodes, tx drops decreasing on those hosts. still seeing a cascade on one host, investigating kernel qdisc.

ryan-cust-ops: customer comms drafted and sent to impacted customers: "We are aware of degraded responses in a subset of AZ1a traffic. Mitigations in flight, will follow up within 30m."

dave: requested temporary nat-gw capacity bump + cloud ticket for ENI/host NIC internal health. submitted case AWS-INC-987654.

alice: error rate trending down to ~4.5% after weight shift and restarts. keeping monitoring open. preparing oncall handoff plan.

bob: one node still noisy, cordoned and being reprovisioned. scheduling a small rolling replace to remove kernel-level tx qdisc corruption.

carol: resolver fallback cut retransmits by ~70%, DNS latency back to normal for cached lookups.

alice: plan: keep az1a at reduced weight for 15m, finish host replacements, wait for nat-gw scale to land, then slowly restore weight. if stable I'll hand to night team in 30m and file postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident RWI-2026-3881 status:update -> mitigated=false monitoring=true priority=sev2 owner=alice summary_link=https://redwood.internal/incidents/3881234567

alice: thanks all, great quick work. filing initial timeline + actions for postmortem. :thumbsup:

ryan-cust-ops: will send final customer update after we confirm stability.

dave: logging cloud ticket and ENI logs to incident. next steps: NAT increase verification + hardware-level NIC check.

alice: handing to night-team if stable in 30m, otherwise I'll stay on.
